title: 第六十八回 孝天犬第六十七回 一言即祸
slug: 驭音心经第七十回狼心逞乱
lines: 孤鹤雁帅众一行，策马兼程，至夕阳西下，来至西海。
世子奇并马来至跟前，似恭敬，又似试探：“孤仙人，鞍马劳顿，可否找地儿安歇？”
孤鹤雁甚奇此子。虽是嫡出皇子，却不见其峥嵘风骨。反倒一路行来，虚言妄言，牢骚不断。孤鹤雁报仇心切，便道：“前方战事吃紧，你我皆负重托。不若趁天色未晚，过了西海再歇，可好？”
世子奇似早有预料，随口便答：“晚生无有仙术，力又不逮。不若仙人先行，吾随后再到，可好？”
两人皆以问作答，大出彼此意料。
正此时，天色突变，血色漫染天际，远方更有一队铁骑，猎猎旌旗，卷土而来。
世子奇见状惊惶：“莫不是妖兵杀至？”拨马便走，随众慌乱。
孤鹤雁幻色紫绫一抖，勒住其马头：“小王爷，此地距前方尚有千里，何惧之有？”
人心稍定。待那队伍来至近前，却是李未带兵赶到。
李未下马，单膝跪倒：“微臣李未，给王爷与孤仙人请安。”
世子奇惊疑：“李未？父皇命你督运粮草，你因何在此？”
李未只是虚礼，起身嘿嘿一笑：“圣上早有书到，料二位爷今日到此，令我出关相迎，并呈前方急报。”随即取出一封文书。
世子奇正待去接，李未却径直呈于孤鹤雁。
世子奇羞恼，将手中马鞭一提，高声唤道：“狗儿——”
李未小名李狗儿。父母双亡，乃四皇子于人贩手中以四两纹银购得，入了王府才改称李未。李未一脸赔笑：“王爷请讲。”
世子奇居高临下，态度倨傲：“爷一路奔波，人马困乏。可有地儿给爷安歇？本主儿还从未出过这么大门，实在乏透了！”
李未陪笑：“爷，前方即是西海。卑职已命人备好馆舍，摆下酒宴，扫街清道，专为二位爷接风。爷随我入城便是。”
世子奇端起架子：“还要多远？”
“不需二十里。”
“二十里？！”世子奇郁闷。
李未与孤鹤雁相视一笑：“爷，打马一鞭即是。”
孤鹤雁抬头指天：“天色为何这般异象？”
李未道：“此地距沙漠不远。沙尘将至，故而惊变。”
言语间，风沙簌簌，扑面而来。众人慌忙入城寻歇。
至晚住下，一起用膳。席间酒叙，孤鹤雁问李未：“李大人，怎地再见如此消瘦？”
李未起身施礼：“孤仙人切勿如此称呼。小人土名狗儿，乃皇上于人贩手中购得，大字不识几个。仙人尊前，不敢托大。请仙人直唤小人贱名即可。”
孤鹤雁微微颔首。
李未方道：“兵法云，兵马未动，粮草先行。圣上命我总督前方粮草，卑职岂敢有失。自担此任，呕心沥血，披星戴月，不敢有丝……咳、咳、咳……”
言及此处，捂胸连咳。咳喘间，竟自项间抖出一链——链上坠一石，曜黑晶亮，内蕴蓝光，甚是抢眼。
孤鹤雁一惊，指石而问曰：“汝于何处得此物？知其异乎？”
李未见问，捧石情动：“此物乃皇上御赐钦封，名曰摩星坠，世间罕有！”
孤鹤雁再问：“那你可识得此物根源？”
李未摇头：“不识。只闻此物乃年大将军阵前所得，进献皇上，并请皇上赐名转授于臣，以促臣心。但使努力供给，不使前方有后顾之忧。”
孤鹤雁闻听再问：“如此说来，你可有得罪年将军之处？”
李未、世子奇何等精明，闻言骤惊。
content_en:
Lone Crane, Yan, and his entourage rode horses and horses until they reached the West Sea as the sun set.
Shi Ziqi rode up to him, seeming to be respectful, but also seeming to test: "I am a lonely immortal, my saddle and horse are tired, can you find a place to rest?"
Gu Heyan is very surprised about this son. Although he is a legitimate prince, he does not have any outstanding character. On the contrary, along the way, he made false claims and complained constantly. Gu Heyan was eager for revenge, so he said: "The war ahead is tense, and you and I both bear a heavy responsibility. How about we rest after crossing the West Sea before it gets too late?"
Shi Ziqi seemed to have expected it, and he answered casually: "I am born late and have no magical skills, and I am not strong enough. If the immortal goes first, I will come later, okay?"
Both of them answered questions, much to each other's surprise.
At this time, the sky suddenly changed, and the sky was stained with blood. In the distance, a group of iron cavalry came in, hunting for flags.
Shi Ziqi was horrified when he saw this: "Could it be that demon soldiers are coming to kill you?" He turned his horse and left, following the crowd in panic.
Lone Crane Yan's phantom-colored purple silk quivered and he reined in his horse's head: "My young prince, this place is still a thousand miles away from the front, why should we be afraid?"
People's hearts are a little calmer. When the team came closer, it was Li Wei who arrived with his troops.
Li Wei dismounted and knelt down on one knee: "Weak minister Li Wei, please pay your respects to the prince and the lonely immortal."
Shi Ziqi was surprised: "Li Wei? My father ordered you to supervise the transportation of grain and grass. Why are you here?"
Li Wei was just a polite gesture, and stood up with a smile: "Your Majesty, a letter has arrived a long time ago. I expected the two masters to be here today, and asked me to come out to greet them and submit an urgent report from the front." Then he took out a document.
Shi Ziqi was waiting to pick him up, but Li Wei went straight to Gu Heyan.
The prince was so embarrassed that he raised the riding crop in his hand and shouted loudly: "Dog——"
Li Wei's nickname is Li Gou'er. Both of his parents died, so the fourth prince bought him from a trafficker for four taels of silver, and changed his name to Li Wei after entering the palace. Li Wei smiled apologetically: "Your Majesty, please speak."
Shi Ziqi was condescending and had an arrogant attitude: "I have been running all the way, and my troops and horses are tired. Is there a place for me to rest? I have never been out of such a gate. I am really exhausted!"
Li Wei smiled and said: "Sir, the West Sea is ahead of us. I have ordered people to prepare the hotel, hold banquets, and sweep the streets, just to welcome the wind for you two. I will follow me into the city."
Shi Ziqi raised his eyebrows: "How far is it?"
"It doesn't take twenty miles."
"Twenty miles?!" Shi Ziqi was depressed.
Li Wei and Gu Heyan looked at each other and smiled: "Master, just give the horse a whip."
Gu Heyan raised his head and pointed to the sky: "Why is the sky so strange?"
Li Weidao: "This place is not far from the desert. The sand and dust are coming, so there is a sudden change."
As he spoke, the wind and sand rushed towards his face. Everyone hurried into the city to find rest.
Stay overnight and have dinner together. During the banquet, Gu Heyan asked Li Wei: "Master Li, how come you are so thin again?"
Li Wei stood up and saluted: "Young Immortal, please don't call me that. The villain's local name is Gou'er. The emperor bought it from a trafficker. He doesn't know a few characters. I don't dare to entrust you to the immortal in front of me. Please just call the villain by his humble name."
Gu Heyan nodded slightly.
Li Weifang said: "The Art of War says that before the soldiers and horses are moved, food and grass go first. The Holy Emperor ordered me to be the governor of the front, so how dare I fail in my humble duty? I take on this responsibility, work hard, wear the stars and the moon, and don't dare to have a trace... cough, cough, cough..."
Speaking of this, I covered my chest and coughed. While coughing and panting, a chain was shaken out from his neck - a stone dropped from the chain. It was black and sparkling, with blue light inside, which was very eye-catching.
Gu Heyan was startled, pointed to the stone and asked, "Where did you get this thing? Do you know how different it is?"
Li Wei saw the question and held the stone with emotion: "This thing is a royal seal given by the emperor. It's called the Moxing Pendant. It's rare in the world!"
Gu Heyan asked again: "Then can you know the origin of this thing?"
Li Wei shook his head: "I don't know. I only heard that this thing was obtained by the Nian General in front of the formation. He presented it to the emperor and asked the emperor to name it and pass it on to the ministers to encourage the ministers. But please work hard to provide it so as not to worry about the future."
Gu Heyan heard this and asked again: "So, have you offended General Nian in any way?"
Li Wei and Shi Ziqi were so shrewd that they were shocked when they heard this.
